Then erase all remotes codes from the control board and reprogram them to have a try. If it fails, please instantaneously short (plug the wire in, then pull it out immediately) the push button terminals (4# and 5#) to check whether the opener can work. Checked with our engineer, please help us do some tests to find out the problem, so that we can provide corresponding help.

1. Check if the blue light on the remote lights up when a button is pressed. If not, replace the two CR2025 batteries and try again. Next, erase the remote codes and reprogram the remote following the instructions in the user manual. Then test whether the remote operates the gate opener.

2. Try moving the remote closer to the gate opener. If that helps, adjust the antenna on the control board—experiment with its position, angle, and direction to improve the signal.

3. Use a jumper wire to momentarily short the push button terminals on the control board (briefly touch and remove the wire), and observe whether the gate opener responds. Repeat the test several times to check if it triggers reliably each time. If so, the gate opener system should be fine, please observe the surrounding environment for any potential sources of signal interference, such as nearby high-voltage power lines, large transformers, metal fences, telecom base stations, or radio transmission towers. 4. Disengage the clutch and manually check whether the gate moves smoothly. If not so smooth, please check the gate, installation and lubricate the arm if necessary. Then keep the clutch disengaged and press the remote—observe whether the gate opener responds each time. If so, the motor and control board should be fine, the issue should be with extra mechanical resistance. Please double check the gate, installation and lubricate the arm if necessary to eliminate the resistance. If the motor still cannot respond properly, the control board or the motor might be defective. You can test the motor by disconnecting the RED & BLACK wires of the arm from the control board and directly connecting the wires to the LOAD output terminal of a DC 24V power source, the motor should run (please listen to the motor sounds). Then exchange polarity of the wires, the arm should run in the opposite direction. results.generated_reply_en:
Dear Nick,

Thank you for contacting TOPENS. This is Heidi from TOPENS Customer Service Team. It will be a pleasure to assist you today.

Thank you for your detailed description and the photo of your gate setup. I understand you need two dual swing gate opener kits for your semi-detached property in the UK and are comparing several models. Do not worry, I will clarify the differences and help you make the right choice.

At TOPENS, all of our products come with a 12-month warranty. More importantly, we provide lifetime technical support via email.

Let me break down the models and your requirements.

1. Model Comparison: The AT1202, AT602, and A8132 are articulated arm openers, while the KD702 is a ram (linear) arm opener. The key differences are in power and application. The AT1202 is our heavy-duty model with a powerful motor, ideal for heavy or long gates. The AT602 and A8132 are lighter-duty models, perfect for gates weighing 20-30kg like yours. The A8132 is essentially a newer version of the AT602 with identical core specifications, so choosing between them often comes down to price and availability. The KD702 uses an electro-mechanical ram which can be simpler for certain post configurations. For your lightweight 3-meter aluminum gates, the AT602 or A8132 would be a perfect, cost-effective match.

2. Remote Control and Gate Access: The M12 remotes included in the kits are programmable. For your scenario, you would program the remotes for the first house to only open the first gate or gate set, and the remotes for the second house to only open their respective gate set. They will not open both at the same time unless you intentionally program one remote to do so. You can absolutely have your requested 6 remotes for your house and 2 for the neighboring house.

3. TC196 WiFi Remote: Yes, the TC196 WiFi remote module can be set to control just one gate opener (one control board) or both, depending on how you configure it within the app. You would simply install one TC196 module on each of the two control boards and then control them independently from your phone.

4. Accessories: The TC175P touch panel keypads and TC148 push button switches you plan to use are fully compatible with all the mentioned models. Since you will be wiring in these continuously-powered accessories, please ensure your power supply is stable. If you ever plan to use solar panels, you'll need to increase the panel power and battery capacity to compensate for the extra consumption.

Our Recommendation: For your setup with two lightweight gates per house, I suggest the AT602 or A8132. They offer the best balance of price and reliable functionality for your gate weight and size.

If you are purchasing from the UK Amazon store, you can search for "TOPENS AT602 Dual Swing Gate Opener" or "TOPENS A8132 Dual Swing Gate Opener" to find the current listing.

Please let me know the result of your search, or share the order information when you purchase, so I can help you register the warranty. Feel free to contact us if you have any questions or concerns during product installation and use in the future.

Thank you once again for being a valued customer! Your complete satisfaction is what we strive for. We at TOPENS are always standing by and ready to help.

Best regards,
Heidi

Thank you for contacting TOPENS. This is Joyce from TOPENS Customer Service Team. It will be a pleasure to assist you today.

I am sorry to hear about the binding and remote issues with your gate opener, but do not worry, we will do our best to help you. All TOPENS products are backed by a 12-month warranty.

Checked with our engineer, please help us do some tests to find out the problem, so that we can provide corresponding help.

1. I know you've already tried to adjust the stall force down to almost nothing. Could you please power off the system first, then increase the stall force slightly using the FORCE potentiometer on the control board? After adjusting it, power the system back on and allow the opener to complete one full operating cycle to see if the gate behaves differently.

2. For Pull-to-Open Installation Mode, the open position is determined by the gate bracket. Please check if the moving rod is properly retracted when your gate is at the desired open position. If the gate is still opening too far and binding, adjust the gate bracket inward a little. If you are using Push-to-Open Installation Mode instead, please adjust Limit Switch B inward on the arm, then press the remote to open the gate and see if the open position changes.

3. Regarding the remote not picking up, please kindly clear all remote codes from the control board first, then try reprogramming the remotes again. Are all the remotes the original M12 remotes included with our system?

Please let me know the result one by one.

Videos showing the problem and pictures of the whole control board wiring are much appreciated for further judgement. You can directly send the video to my E-mail via the attachment. If the sending is not successful, please share the photo or video link through dropbox, icloud or google drive. Thanks for your understanding and cooperation.

And also please reply with your specific SHIPPING ADDRESS with zip code and confirm your PHONE # available for further assistance.

Thank you again for being a valued customer! Your complete satisfaction is what we strive for. We at TOPENS are always standing by and ready to help.

Best regards,
Joyce
TOPENS Customer Service Team

1. Please measure the voltage of the +BAT- terminals (11# and 12#) on the control board to see whether it is above 22V. If the voltage is below 22V, please check whether the output voltage of the adapter is 36VDC. If so, disconnect the batteries from the control board and measure the output voltage of the batteries to see whether it is above DC 22V. If the voltage of the batteries is also below 22V, please keep the batteries charged fully to try it again.

2. Please check whether the power LED on the control board is ON (blinks twice per second). If it is off, check whether the fuse was burnt out and replace the fuse if necessary. There is a backup fuse packed within the user manual pack. The fuse type is ∅5*20mm 5A 250VAC fast blow glass fuse.

3. Please check all the wires are connected as they should be according to the manual.

Please let me know the result one by one. Videos showing the problem and pictures of the whole control board are much appreciated for further judgement. results.generated_reply_en:
Dear Heidi,

Thank you for contacting TOPENS. This is Heidi from TOPENS Customer Service Team. It will be a pleasure to assist you today.

I'm sorry to hear your gate has started acting differently recently. Do not worry, we will do our best to help you. All TOPENS products are backed by a 12-month warranty.

Since your gate is a Pull-to-Open installation, the open position is determined by the gate bracket, not the limit switch. Checked with our engineer, please help us do some tests to find out the problem, so that we can provide corresponding help.

1. Please double check all the brackets and hardware of the arm (including the screw of the limit switch) are secured since the looseness of the brackets or limit switch may also cause this issue.

2. Power off the system, turn the FORCE potentiometer clockwise to increase the stall force to max. Then turn on the power and operate the gate opener to run for a complete opening & closing cycle. See whether the gate will open and close normally in the next opening and closing cycle.

3. For Pull-to-Open Installation Mode, the open position is determined by the gate bracket. Please check if the moving rod is properly retracted when your gate is at the desired open position. Adjust the gate bracket inward a little if necessary because if the gate opens too far it can get binded and bounce back.

4. If the issue is still unresolved, please use the release key to disengage the clutches of both arms, and check whether the gate itself can be manually opened & closed freely 3.3 feet (one meter) away from the gate hinge. If not, please let me know the weight and length of your gate and double check the gate to make sure the gate can run freely by hand.

5. If the above step is fine, please take down the arm from the gate and hold its front mount with a hand. Then press the remote to see if the arm can extend and retract properly each time.

Please kindly let us know the results of each step one by one so that we can better determine the problem. Video showing the problem would be greatly appreciated. If the sending is not successful, please share the photo or video link through dropbox, icloud or google drive.

Thank you once again for being a valued customer! Your complete satisfaction is what we strive for. We at TOPENS are always standing by and ready to help.

Best regards,
Heidi
TOPENS Customer Service Team
